plan: A wandering support who opens portals through walls and freezes everything in time with his ultimate.
aSurveiller: His Q (Cosmic Binding). It stuns you if you are near a wall or another enemy: stay away from walls when facing him.
contrer: Don't stand near a wall or an ally: his Q stuns both lined-up targets.
Watch out for his portals (E): he can appear from behind a wall.
During his R, targets are untouchable: don't waste your spells on them.
forces: His R freezes everyone in an area.
Heals his allies with his shrines.

sorts.P: Collects chimes; his Meeps empower his attacks.
sorts.Q: Projectile that stuns against a wall or an enemy.
sorts.R: Freezes all units in an area.

momentFort: Useful all game, stronger and stronger with his chimes.
